As a main agent, the model chosen in the chat window takes precedence.

en.preset.builtIn.cordisHint: Customize DSH through conversation. Let the agent write plugins that add features or UI, or combine tools and prompts to create your own mode.
en.preset.builtIn.minimalHint: The agent works using only a terminal tool. Useful for testing and comparing its basic performance.
en.preset.builtIn.ptcHint: Includes all Standard mode capabilities. Better suited to tasks that call tools in batches and then filter, organize, deduplicate, count, or summarize the results.
en.preset.builtIn.standardHint: Work with code, files, and information. Suitable for most tasks, with search, editing, terminal commands, and other tools available as needed.
en.preset.createNote: "New" registers a fresh preset from the source preset's composition (prompt composition, skills, resources), leaving the source untouched; an empty description inherits the source preset's.
en.preset.deleteConfirm: Delete the preset "{name}"? Its registration is revoked and its definition is removed from the configuration; this cannot be undone.
en.preset.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional; shown when picking the preset in a session

en.section.coldHint: No platform preset list collected yet — send a message in any session to trigger an assembly, then come back and they will be listed here.
en.section.customNote: The body is sent as-is; platform-registered {{变量}} placeholders are replaced with their current values (see "Available variables" above). Writing a variable the platform has not registered fails that request outright.
en.section.emptyBody: (The platform currently supplies an empty section — it simply has no body under this preset.)
en.section.emptyShort: (the platform currently supplies an empty section)
en.section.ghostNote: The platform lists no section with this name — the name may be misspelled, or the platform may have dropped it. This section delivers no content.
en.section.group.toolGuide: ② Tool usage guidance (keep the sections of the tools you enabled so the model knows how to use them)
en.section.notCollected: The platform had no body for it this time. Send a message in any session to trigger an assembly, then reopen this dialog to see it.
en.section.notCollectedShort: (body not collected — trigger an assembly to see it)
en.section.noTextNote: The platform gave no body for this section this time — trigger an assembly and its full content will show up here.
en.section.pickerNoBody: (the platform currently supplies no body for this section — it may simply be empty under this preset)
en.section.platformNote: This section references the platform body (updated whenever the platform is), and is read-only here.
en.section.ptcOnlyNote: PTC only: declares "tools may only be called through run_code" — exclude it and the model calls tools by name directly (and gets an unknown-tool error).
en.section.ptcRequired: Required for PTC mode · takes effect only in PTC mode
en.section.sdkNote: PTC only: the run_code SDK declaration generated from the current tool catalog — exclude it and the model sees no tools at all.
en.set.skillHint: Groups skills; only the part the AI recognizes and calls is affected
en.set.toolHint:
Groups tools; with nothing checked there is no tool at all
To initialize / refresh: send one message in standard mode, then come back.
en.shell.failedHint: Most likely the plugin was just updated, or the host's static route is not ready yet. Retry below; if it still fails, restart DSH once.
en.shell.failedTitle: The Agent Studio panel module failed to load
en.shell.loadingHint: The panel code is loaded from the host at runtime, so the first open takes a moment.
en.skill.coldHint: No skill list read. Opening the panel queries the official skill service directly (no message needed first); if this stays empty, this deployment has no skills.
en.skill.rankHint: For same-named skills the platform priority wins:
